scope: Targeted primary-methods review spanning journal years2022-2026; selected prominent systems and major validation collaborations, not a systematic citation-ranked census. FPP integrations are distinguished from MCMC chains/steps and ephemeris fits.

papers.notes: TRICERATOPS author-led validation study; count is per TOI, not20 transit fits.

papers.title: THYME IX: HD109833 two-planet system
papers.ephemeris_evidence: No separate recovered/final repetition sets stated in inspected methods.

papers.title: A Second Earth-Sized Planet in the Habitable Zone of the M Dwarf TOI700
papers.summary_statistic: A reported VESPA FPP; independent repeat count not stated

papers.notes: Different framework: no reported count must not be interpreted as exactly one run.

papers.title: The TESS-Keck Survey XX:15New TESS Planets and a Uniform RV Analysis
papers.ephemeris_evidence: No separate recovered/final repetition sets stated in inspected validation section.
papers.notes: Requires3sigma clearance of FPP/NFPP thresholds. This is a different decision rule from our retained mean criterion.

papers.title: A1.55Earth-radius habitable-zone planet hosted by TOI715

papers.title: Two Earth-size Planets and an Earth-size Candidate Transiting HD101581
papers.ephemeris_evidence: A fitted P/T0 model is presented inIV; V.4 reports10repetitions without a recovered/final split. Exact FPP clock handoff not separately specified.

papers.title: Validation of TESS Planet Candidates with Multicolor Transit Photometry and TRICERATOPS+
papers.ephemeris_evidence: Most TESS curves initially folded at ExoFOP ephemerides; one target refitted in time. Separate FPP batches compare data configurations, not two clock sets.
papers.notes: Explicitly chooses10instead of recommended20because expanded data increase per-run cost; this is a valid published lower-count precedent, not a universal precision guarantee.

papers.title: Multicolour Validation of Two Temperate Mini-Neptunes Around M-dwarf Habitable Zones
papers.ephemeris_evidence: TRICERATOPS screening followed by a separate joint multicolour Bayesian comparison; no stated two-clock repetition split.

papers.title: Assessing the Impact of High-Resolution Imaging on Statistical Validation of TESS Planet Candidates
papers.summary_statistic: Mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum
papers.ephemeris_evidence: 20independent runs explicitly at recovery-stage inputs; recomputation at final native-MCMC period/epoch with other inputs fixed; final-stage seed count not independently stated.
papers.notes: Requires thresholds at both clocks;8targets fail final-clock consistency. Contrast/no-contrast20-seed sets are another experiment, not a recovered/final10+10split.

additional_pipeline_example.title: COUNTESS I: A Uniformly Vetted Catalog
additional_pipeline_example.ephemeris_evidence: Uses search/fit-derived inputs; no stated separate two-clock seed sets.
additional_pipeline_example.notes: Kept as additional pipeline example, not the principal strict-validation precedent; main methods also discuss likely-planet thresholds.

analysis.primary_run: Use the independently justified best-fitting ephemeris for the principal scientific FPP, not the clock yielding the smallest FPP. This is an inference/recommendation, not a universal rule quoted from every paper.
analysis.recovered_run: Sensitivity/robustness check to ephemeris choice, not independent photons or another planet detection.
analysis.repetitions: Estimate numerical scatter conditional on the model/data. For independent finite-variance estimates,SEM scales1/sqrt(N);10has sqrt(2) times the SEM of20. Sparse/heavy-tailed weights weaken this approximation.
analysis.ephemeris_uncertainty: Two fixed clocks do not by themselves marginalize the full period/epoch posterior.
analysis.precision: Counts alone cannot be compared as equal precision across samplers,observations,scenario censuses and per-run draws.
analysis.threshold_integrity: No threshold,mean rule,seed,draw count,input or receipt changed. Do not stop upon the first favorable repeat or pool different-clock estimates.
